'''Deianora Bentledown''', formally styled as '''Her Excellency Lady Deianora Bentledown''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:LBSH">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Lady Bentledown Seeks Hunters}}</ref>
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Deianora Bentledown was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LBSH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
